slug: 2025-06-05 São Tomé and Principe pilots MOSIP-based national digital ID system

STP.note: The document states no authentication, e-signature or PKI service.

facts.fact: A Justice Ministry official says the MOSIP-based digital ID pilot is anchored on birth registration and that 'we started with civil registration'.

STP.note: Gives 98% of the population with a birth certificate (World Bank, 2023), not people enrolled in the ID system.
States no number given at birth.
Pilot only; states no operator, maintainer or in-service ownership.
States no public register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: A Justice Ministry official says the country is in the pilot phase of a national digital ID on MOSIP, begun in 2024, with no fixed timeline for full-scale deployment.
